title: Amazon S3 with S3 Object Lambda
description: Use S3 Object Lambda to return a thumbnail version of an S3 object.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The SAM template deploys a Lambda function, an S3 bucket, an S3 Access Point, and an S3 Object Lambda Access Point. This application uses S3 Object Lambda to return a thumbnail version of an image in S3. The Lambda function execution role has CRUD access to the S3 bucket and s3-object-lambda:WriteGetObjectResponse.
